أيّتها العذراء مريم، أمّ المحبّة الجميلة، الأمّ التي لم تترك يومًا ولدًا يصرخ مستنجدًا، والأمّ التي تعمل يداها دون توقُّف من أجل أولادها المحبوبين، لأنّ الحبّ الإلهيّ هو الذي يدفعها، وتفيض من قلبها الرحمة اللامتناهية، أميلي نظرك المليء بالشفقة إليّ. أُنظري إلى رزمة «العُقَد» التي تخنق حياتي. إنّك تعرفين يأسي وألمي، وتعرفين كم تعيقني هذه العُقَد.

يا مريم، الأمّ التي كلَّفها الله بحلّ «عُقَد» حياة أولادها، إنّي أضع شريطة حياتي بين يديك. لا أحد، حتّى المحتال، يمكنه أن يطرح شريطة حياتي بعيدًا عن مساعدتكِ الرحومة. بين يديكِ، لا توجد عُقدة واحدة لا يمكن حلّها.

أيّتها الأمّ الكليّة القدرة، بنعمتك وقوّة شفاعتكِ لدى ابنك يسوع، محرّري، اقبلي اليوم هذه «العُقدة»… (تسميتها إذا أمكن). لمجد الله، أطلب إليك حلَّها، وحلِّها إلى الأبد. فيكِ أضع رجائي.

يا مريم، أنتِ التي تحلّ العُقَد، صلّي لأجلي.

أنتِ المعزيّة الوحيدة التي أعطاني إيّاها الله، أنتِ قلعة لقواي الضعيفة، وغنًى لأوهاني، وخلاص لكلّ ما يمنعني من أن أكون مع المسيح. إقبلي دعائي، احفظيني، أرشديني، احميني، أنتِ ملجأي الأكيد.

يا مريم، أنتِ التي تحلّ العُقَد، صلّي لأجلي.

المجد للآب والابن والروح القدس، الإله الواحد، آمين.

اليوم التاسع
باسم الآب والابن والروح القدس، الإله الواحد، آمين.

نتلوا فعل الندامة

يا ربي وإلهي، أنا نادم من كل قلبي على جميع خطاياي، لأنـي بالخطيئة خسرتُ نفسي والخيرات الأبديـة، واستحققت العذابات الجهنمية. وبالأكثر أنا نادم، لأنـي أغظتك وأهنتك، أنت ربي وإلهي المستحق كل كرامة ومحبـة. ولهذا السبب أبغض الخطيئة فوق كل شر. وأريد بنعمتك أن أموت، قبل أن أغيظك فيما بعد. وأقصد أن أهرب من كل سبب خطيئة، وأن أفي بقدر استطاعتي عن الخطايا التي فعلتهـا. آميـن.

نطلب السماح عن الخطايا التي ارتكبناها، ونأخذ قصداً ثابتاً بعدم الرجوع اليها.

نتلوا الابيات الثلاثة الاولى من مسبحة الوردية.

تأمل اليوم التاسع

أيّتها الأمُّ القدّيسة، المحامية عنَّا، أنتِ التي تحلُّ «العُقَد»، أنا آتٍ اليوم لأشكرَك على قبولك حلّ هذه «العُقدة» في حياتي. إنّكِ تعرفين ما تُسبِّبه لي من ألَم. أشكرك أيّتها الأمُّ، لأنّك مسحتِ برحمتِكِ دموعَ عينيّ. أشكركِ على قبولي بين ذراعيكِ وعلى سماحكِ لي بقبول نعمةً أُخرى من الله. يا «مريم التي تحلُّ العُقَد»، يا أمّي المحبوبة، أشكركِ على حلّ «العُقَد» في حياتي. أحيطيني برداءِ حبّكِ واحفظيني بحمايتكِ وأنيريني بسلامِك.

“يا مريم التي تحلُّ العُقَد”، صلّي لأجلي.

نتلوا البيتين الاخيرين من مسبحة الوردية.

صلاة لمريم التي تحلُّ العُقَد

أيّتها العذراء مريم، أمّ المحبّة الجميلة، الأمّ التي لم تترك يومًا ولدًا يصرخ مستنجدًا، والأمّ التي تعمل يداها دون توقُّف من أجل أولادها المحبوبين، لأنّ الحبّ الإلهيّ هو الذي يدفعها، وتفيض من قلبها الرحمة اللامتناهية، أميلي نظرك المليء بالشفقة إليّ. أُنظري إلى رزمة «العُقَد» التي تخنق حياتي. إنّك تعرفين يأسي وألمي، وتعرفين كم تعيقني هذه العُقَد.

Neuvaine à Marie qui défait les nœuds

PREMIER JOUR

Au nom du Père, et du Fils, et du Saint-Esprit, Dieu unique. Amen.

Acte de contrition

Ô mon Seigneur et mon Dieu, je regrette de tout mon cœur tous mes péchés, car, par le péché, j'ai perdu mon âme et les biens éternels, et j'ai mérité les tourments de l'enfer. Mais surtout, je regrette de Vous avoir offensé et déplu, Vous, mon Seigneur et mon Dieu, qui êtes digne de tout honneur et de tout amour. C'est pourquoi je déteste le péché plus que tout autre mal. Avec votre grâce, je préférerais mourir plutôt que de Vous offenser de nouveau. Je prends la résolution d'éviter toute occasion de péché et, autant que possible, de réparer les péchés que j'ai commis. Amen.

Demandons pardon pour les péchés que nous avons commis et prenons la ferme résolution de ne plus y retomber.

Récitons les trois premières dizaines du chapelet.

Méditation du premier jour

Très chère Sainte Mère, Très Sainte Marie, Vous qui défaites les nœuds qui étouffent vos enfants, étendez vers moi vos mains miséricordieuses. Aujourd'hui, je Vous confie ce « nœud »… (nommez-le, si possible), ainsi que toutes les conséquences négatives qu'il entraîne dans ma vie. Je Vous remets ce nœud qui me tourmente, me rend malheureux et m'empêche d'être uni à Vous et à votre Fils Jésus, mon Sauveur.

Je me tourne vers Vous, Marie, qui défaites les nœuds, parce que j'ai confiance en Vous et que je sais que Vous n'avez jamais rejeté un enfant pécheur qui implore votre secours. Je crois que Vous pouvez défaire ce nœud, car Jésus Vous a donné toute autorité. J'ai confiance en Vous : Vous accueillerez ce nœud et le déferez, parce que Vous êtes ma Mère. Je sais que Vous le ferez, parce que Vous m'aimez de l'amour même de Dieu. Merci, ma Mère bien-aimée.

Marie, qui défaites les nœuds, priez pour moi.

Celui qui cherche une grâce la trouvera entre les mains de Marie.

Récitons les deux dernières dizaines du chapelet.

Prière à Marie qui défait les nœuds

Vierge Marie, Mère du bel Amour, Mère qui n'avez jamais abandonné un enfant qui crie vers Vous au secours, Mère dont les mains travaillent sans cesse pour vos enfants bien-aimés, mue par l'amour divin et remplie de l'infinie miséricorde qui jaillit de votre cœur, tournez vers moi votre regard compatissant. Voyez l'enchevêtrement de nœuds qui étouffe ma vie. Vous connaissez mon désespoir et ma douleur, et Vous savez combien ces nœuds m'entravent.

Marie, Mère à qui Dieu a confié la mission de défaire les nœuds dans la vie de vos enfants, je dépose le ruban de ma vie entre vos mains. Personne, pas même le Malin, ne peut arracher le ruban de ma vie à votre sollicitude miséricordieuse. Entre vos mains, il n'est aucun nœud qui ne puisse être défait.

Mère toute-puissante, par votre grâce et par la puissance de votre intercession auprès de votre Fils Jésus, mon Rédempteur, recevez aujourd'hui ce nœud… (nommez-le, si possible). Pour la gloire de Dieu, je Vous demande de le défaire et de le défaire pour toujours. Je mets mon espérance en Vous.

Vous êtes l'unique Consolatrice que Dieu m'ait donnée, le refuge de ma faiblesse, la richesse de ma pauvreté et la délivrance de tout ce qui m'empêche d'être avec le Christ. Accueillez ma prière, gardez-moi, guidez-moi et protégez-moi. Vous êtes mon sûr refuge.

Marie, Vous qui défaites les nœuds, priez pour moi.

Gloire au Père, et au Fils, et au Saint-Esprit, Dieu unique, maintenant et pour toujours. Amen.

Méditation du deuxième jour

Marie, ma Mère bien-aimée, source de toutes les grâces, mon cœur se tourne aujourd'hui vers Vous. Je reconnais que je suis pécheur et que j'ai besoin de votre aide. À cause de mon égoïsme, de mon ressentiment, de mon manque de générosité et de mon manque d'humilité, je n'ai souvent pas su apprécier les grâces que Vous obtenez pour moi.

Aujourd'hui, je me tourne vers Vous, Marie, qui défaites les nœuds, et je Vous demande d'obtenir de votre Fils Jésus la pureté du cœur, le détachement, l'humilité et la confiance. Je mettrai ces vertus en pratique aujourd'hui et je Vous les offrirai comme signe de mon amour. Je dépose entre vos mains ce nœud… (nommez-le, si possible), qui m'empêche de refléter la gloire de Dieu.

Marie, qui défaites les nœuds, priez pour moi.

Marie offrait à Dieu chaque instant de sa journée.

Devant Vous, Mère bien-aimée, et au nom de votre Fils Jésus, mon Sauveur, si souvent offensé et qui a su pardonner, je pardonne maintenant à ces personnes… et je me pardonne à moi-même pour toujours. Merci, Marie, qui défaites les nœuds, d'avoir dénoué le nœud du ressentiment dans mon cœur ainsi que celui que je dépose maintenant devant Vous. Amen.

Marie, qui défaites les nœuds, priez pour moi.

Celui qui désire recevoir des grâces doit se tourner vers Marie.

Marchez avec moi, Mère bien-aimée, afin que je comprenne que ces pierres peuvent devenir des amies. Aidez-moi à cesser de me plaindre, à apprendre à rendre grâce en tout temps et à sourire avec confiance en votre puissance.

Marie, qui défaites les nœuds, priez pour moi.

Méditation du sixième jour

Préparez mon cœur à célébrer avec les anges la grâce que Vous obtenez pour moi.

Marie, qui défaites les nœuds, priez pour moi.

Vous êtes belle, Marie, et il n'y a aucune tache en Vous.

Prière à Marie qui défait les nœuds

Voyez l'enchevêtrement de nœuds qui étouffe ma vie. Vous connaissez mon désespoir et ma douleur, et Vous savez combien ces nœuds m'entravent.

NOVENA A MARIA CHE SCIOGLIE I NODI

PRIMO GIORNO

Nel nome del Padre e del Figlio e dello Spirito Santo, unico Dio. Amen.

Atto di contrizione

O mio Signore e mio Dio, sono sinceramente pentito di tutti i miei peccati, perché con il peccato ho perduto la mia anima e i beni eterni e ho meritato i tormenti dell'inferno. Soprattutto, mi pento di averti offeso e contristato, Tu, mio Signore e mio Dio, che sei degno di ogni onore e di ogni amore. Per questo detesto il peccato più di ogni altro male. Con la tua grazia, preferirei morire piuttosto che offenderti ancora. Propongo di evitare ogni occasione di peccato e, per quanto mi sarà possibile, di riparare ai peccati che ho commesso. Amen.

Chiediamo perdono per i peccati commessi e prendiamo la ferma risoluzione di non ricadervi.

Recitiamo le prime tre decine del Rosario.

Meditazione del primo giorno

Carissima Santa Madre, Santissima Maria, tu sciogli i nodi che soffocano i tuoi figli. Stendi verso di me le tue mani misericordiose. Oggi ti affido questo «nodo»… (nominalo, se possibile), insieme a tutte le conseguenze negative che porta nella mia vita. Ti consegno questo nodo che mi tormenta, mi rende infelice e mi impedisce di essere unito a te e a tuo Figlio Gesù, mio Salvatore.

Mi rivolgo a te, Maria, che sciogli i nodi, perché mi fido di te e so che non hai mai respinto un figlio peccatore che invoca il tuo aiuto. Credo che tu possa sciogliere questo nodo, perché Gesù ti ha dato ogni autorità. Confido che tu lo accoglierai e lo scioglierai, perché sei mia Madre. So che lo farai, perché mi ami con l'amore stesso di Dio. Grazie, Madre mia amata.

Maria, che sciogli i nodi, prega per me.

Chi cerca una grazia la troverà nelle mani di Maria.

Recitiamo le ultime due decine del Rosario.

Preghiera a Maria, che scioglie i nodi

Vergine Maria, Madre del Bell'Amore, Madre che non hai mai abbandonato un figlio che grida a te chiedendo aiuto, Madre le cui mani lavorano senza sosta per i tuoi figli amati, mossa dall'amore divino e colma dell'infinita misericordia che sgorga dal tuo cuore, volgi verso di me il tuo sguardo compassionevole. Guarda il groviglio di nodi che soffoca la mia vita. Tu conosci la mia disperazione e il mio dolore, e sai quanto questi nodi mi impediscano di andare avanti.

Maria, Madre alla quale Dio ha affidato il compito di sciogliere i nodi nella vita dei suoi figli, depongo nelle tue mani il nastro della mia vita. Nessuno, neppure il maligno, può strappare il nastro della mia vita dalla tua misericordiosa protezione. Nelle tue mani non esiste nodo che non possa essere sciolto.

Madre onnipotente, per la tua grazia e per la potenza della tua intercessione presso tuo Figlio Gesù, mio Redentore, accogli oggi questo nodo… (nominalo, se possibile). Per la gloria di Dio, ti chiedo di scioglierlo e di scioglierlo per sempre. In te ripongo la mia speranza.

Tu sei l'unica Consolatrice che Dio mi ha donato, il sostegno della mia debolezza, la ricchezza della mia povertà e la liberazione da tutto ciò che mi impedisce di essere con Cristo. Accogli la mia preghiera, custodiscimi, guidami e proteggimi. Tu sei il mio sicuro rifugio.

Maria, tu che sciogli i nodi, prega per me.

Gloria al Padre, al Figlio e allo Spirito Santo, unico Dio, ora e sempre. Amen.

Madre, Mediatrice delle grazie, Regina del Cielo, tu le cui mani ricevono e distribuiscono i tesori del Re, volgi verso di me il tuo sguardo misericordioso. Depongo nelle tue mani sante questo nodo della mia vita… e tutto il risentimento e l'amarezza che ne derivano.

Davanti a te, Madre amata, e nel nome di tuo Figlio Gesù, mio Salvatore, che fu tante volte offeso e seppe perdonare, ora perdono queste persone… e perdono per sempre anche me stesso. Grazie, Maria, che sciogli i nodi, per aver sciolto il nodo del risentimento nel mio cuore e il nodo che ora depongo davanti a te. Amen.

Santissima Madre amata, tu accogli tutti coloro che vengono a te: abbi pietà di me. Depongo nelle tue mani questo nodo… che mi impedisce di vivere nella pace, ostacola il cammino della mia anima e mi impedisce di avvicinarmi al mio Signore e di mettere la mia vita al suo servizio.

Sciogli questo nodo nella mia vita, Madre mia, e chiedi a Gesù di guarire la mia fede vacillante, che inciampa sulle pietre lungo il cammino. Cammina con me, Madre amata, affinché io comprenda che queste pietre possono diventare amiche. Aiutami a smettere di lamentarmi, a imparare a rendere grazie in ogni momento e a sorridere con fiducia nella tua potenza.

Maria, che sciogli i nodi, prega per me.

Maria è il sole il cui calore è goduto da tutti.

Recitiamo le ultime due decine del Rosario.

Preghiera a Maria, che scioglie i nodi

Vergine Maria, Madre del Bell'Amore, Madre che non hai mai abbandonato un figlio che grida a te chiedendo aiuto, Madre le cui mani lavorano senza sosta per i tuoi figli amati, mossa dall'amore divino e colma dell'infinita misericordia che sgorga dal tuo cuore, volgi verso di me il tuo sguardo compassionevole. Guarda il groviglio di nodi che soffoca la mia vita. Tu conosci la mia disperazione e il mio dolore, e sai quanto questi nodi mi impediscano di andare avanti.

Tu sei l'unica Consolatrice che Dio mi ha donato, il sostegno della mia debolezza, la ricchezza della mia povertà e la liberazione da tutto ciò che mi impedisce di essere con Cristo. Accogli la mia preghiera, custodiscimi, guidami e proteggimi. Tu sei il mio sicuro rifugio.

Maria, tu che sciogli i nodi, prega per me.

Gloria al Padre, al Figlio e allo Spirito Santo, unico Dio, ora e sempre. Amen.

QUINTO GIORNO

Nel nome del Padre e del Figlio e dello Spirito Santo, unico Dio. Amen.

Con la tua grazia, preferirei morire piuttosto che offenderti ancora. Propongo di evitare ogni occasione di peccato e, per quanto mi sarà possibile, di riparare ai peccati che ho commesso. Amen.

Liberami dall'amarezza, dalla rabbia e dall'odio che questo nodo ha generato in me.

Maria, che sciogli i nodi, prega per me.

Maria è ricca di potere presso Dio.

Recitiamo le ultime due decine del Rosario.

text.en:
Novena to Mary, Undoer of Knots

DAY ONE

In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, one God. Amen.

Act of Contrition

O my Lord and my God, I am heartily sorry for all my sins, because by sin I have lost my soul and the eternal blessings and have deserved the torments of hell. Above all, I am sorry because I have offended and displeased You, my Lord and my God, who are worthy of all honour and love. For this reason, I detest sin above every evil. By Your grace, I would rather die than offend You again. I resolve to avoid every occasion of sin and, as far as I can, to make reparation for the sins I have committed. Amen.

Let us ask forgiveness for the sins we have committed and make a firm resolution not to return to them.

Pray the first three decades of the Rosary.

Meditation for the First Day

Dearest Holy Mother, Most Holy Mary, you undo the knots that suffocate your children. Extend your merciful hands towards me. Today I entrust to you this “knot”… (name it, if possible), and all the negative consequences it brings into my life. I give you this knot that torments me, makes me unhappy and prevents me from being united with you and with your Son Jesus, my Saviour.

I turn to you, Mary, Undoer of Knots, because I trust you and know that you have never rejected a sinful child who calls upon you for help. I believe that you can undo this knot because Jesus has given you every authority. I trust that you will receive and undo this knot because you are my Mother. I know you will do so because you love me with God's own love. Thank you, my beloved Mother.

Mary, Undoer of Knots, pray for me.

Whoever seeks a grace will find it in Mary's hands.

Pray the last two decades of the Rosary.

Prayer to Mary, Undoer of Knots

Virgin Mary, Mother of fair love, Mother who has never abandoned a child who cries out to you for help, Mother whose hands work without ceasing for your beloved children, moved by divine love and filled with the infinite mercy that flows from your heart, turn your compassionate gaze towards me. Look upon the tangle of knots that suffocates my life. You know my despair and my pain, and you know how these knots hold me back.

Mary, Mother whom God has entrusted with undoing the knots in the lives of your children, I place the ribbon of my life in your hands. No one, not even the evil one, can take the ribbon of my life away from your merciful care. In your hands there is not a single knot that cannot be undone.

Almighty Mother, by your grace and the power of your intercession with your Son Jesus, my Redeemer, receive this knot today… (name it, if possible). For the glory of God, I ask you to undo it and to undo it forever. In you I place my hope.

You are the only Consoler whom God has given me, the stronghold of my weakness, the richness of my poverty, and the deliverance from everything that prevents me from being with Christ. Receive my prayer, keep me, guide me and protect me. You are my sure refuge.

Mary, you who undo knots, pray for me.

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, one God, now and forever. Amen.

DAY TWO

In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, one God. Amen.

Act of Contrition

O my Lord and my God, I am heartily sorry for all my sins, because by sin I have lost my soul and the eternal blessings and have deserved the torments of hell. Above all, I am sorry because I have offended and displeased You, my Lord and my God, who are worthy of all honour and love. For this reason, I detest sin above every evil. By Your grace, I would rather die than offend You again. I resolve to avoid every occasion of sin and, as far as I can, to make reparation for the sins I have committed. Amen.

Let us ask forgiveness for the sins we have committed and make a firm resolution not to return to them.

Pray the first three decades of the Rosary.

Meditation for the Second Day

Mary, my beloved Mother, source of all graces, my heart turns towards you today. I acknowledge that I am a sinner and that I need your help. Because of my selfishness, resentment, lack of generosity and lack of humility, I have often failed to appreciate the graces you obtain for me.

Today I turn to you, Mary, Undoer of Knots, and ask you to obtain from your Son Jesus purity of heart, detachment, humility and trust. I will practise these virtues today and offer them to you as a sign of my love. I place in your hands this knot… (name it, if possible), which prevents me from reflecting the glory of God.

Mary, Undoer of Knots, pray for me.

Mary offered every moment of her day to God.

Pray the last two decades of the Rosary.

Prayer to Mary, Undoer of Knots

Virgin Mary, Mother of fair love, Mother who has never abandoned a child who cries out to you for help, Mother whose hands work without ceasing for your beloved children, moved by divine love and filled with the infinite mercy that flows from your heart, turn your compassionate gaze towards me. Look upon the tangle of knots that suffocates my life. You know my despair and my pain, and you know how these knots hold me back.

Mary, Mother whom God has entrusted with undoing the knots in the lives of your children, I place the ribbon of my life in your hands. No one, not even the evil one, can take the ribbon of my life away from your merciful care. In your hands there is not a single knot that cannot be undone.

Almighty Mother, by your grace and the power of your intercession with your Son Jesus, my Redeemer, receive this knot today… (name it, if possible). For the glory of God, I ask you to undo it and to undo it forever. In you I place my hope.

You are the only Consoler whom God has given me, the stronghold of my weakness, the richness of my poverty, and the deliverance from everything that prevents me from being with Christ. Receive my prayer, keep me, guide me and protect me. You are my sure refuge.

Mary, you who undo knots, pray for me.

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, one God, now and forever. Amen.

DAY THREE

In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, one God. Amen.

Act of Contrition

O my Lord and my God, I am heartily sorry for all my sins, because by sin I have lost my soul and the eternal blessings and have deserved the torments of hell. Above all, I am sorry because I have offended and displeased You, my Lord and my God, who are worthy of all honour and love. For this reason, I detest sin above every evil. By Your grace, I would rather die than offend You again. I resolve to avoid every occasion of sin and, as far as I can, to make reparation for the sins I have committed. Amen.

Let us ask forgiveness for the sins we have committed and make a firm resolution not to return to them.

Pray the first three decades of the Rosary.

Meditation for the Third Day

Mother, Mediatrix of graces, Queen of Heaven, you whose hands receive and distribute the treasures of the King, turn your merciful gaze towards me. I place in your holy hands this knot in my life… and all the resentment and bitterness that arise from it.

I ask you, God the Father, to forgive my sins. Help me now to forgive all those who, knowingly or unknowingly, have caused this knot. The more completely I surrender myself to you, the more fully you can undo it.

Before you, beloved Mother, and in the name of your Son Jesus, my Saviour, who was so often offended and knew how to forgive, I now forgive these people… and I forgive myself forever. Thank you, Mary, Undoer of Knots, for undoing the knot of resentment in my heart and the knot I now place before you. Amen.

Mary, Undoer of Knots, pray for me.

Whoever desires graces should turn to Mary.

Pray the last two decades of the Rosary.

Prayer to Mary, Undoer of Knots

Virgin Mary, Mother of fair love, Mother who has never abandoned a child who cries out to you for help, Mother whose hands work without ceasing for your beloved children, moved by divine love and filled with the infinite mercy that flows from your heart, turn your compassionate gaze towards me. Look upon the tangle of knots that suffocates my life. You know my despair and my pain, and you know how these knots hold me back.

Mary, Mother whom God has entrusted with undoing the knots in the lives of your children, I place the ribbon of my life in your hands. No one, not even the evil one, can take the ribbon of my life away from your merciful care. In your hands there is not a single knot that cannot be undone.

Almighty Mother, by your grace and the power of your intercession with your Son Jesus, my Redeemer, receive this knot today… (name it, if possible). For the glory of God, I ask you to undo it and to undo it forever. In you I place my hope.

You are the only Consoler whom God has given me, the stronghold of my weakness, the richness of my poverty, and the deliverance from everything that prevents me from being with Christ. Receive my prayer, keep me, guide me and protect me. You are my sure refuge.

Mary, you who undo knots, pray for me.

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, one God, now and forever. Amen.

DAY FOUR

In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, one God. Amen.

Act of Contrition

By Your grace, I would rather die than offend You again. I resolve to avoid every occasion of sin and, as far as I can, to make reparation for the sins I have committed. Amen.

Walk with me, beloved Mother, so that I may understand that these stones can become friends. Help me stop complaining, learn to give thanks at all times and smile with confidence in your power.

Mary, Undoer of Knots, pray for me.

Mary is the sun whose warmth is enjoyed by all.

Deliver me from the bitterness, anger and hatred that this knot has produced in me.

Mary, Undoer of Knots, pray for me.

Mary is rich in power before God.

Mary, Undoer of Knots, pray for me.
